'''Iza Paatzee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Kaeline Ungasan]] wished to become a new force in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] criminal activities. Fortunately for him, he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] willing to help him during his stay in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Seeing [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as his greatest obstacle, Ungasan wished to forge an alliance with [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], a powerful enemy of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's empire]]. In order to gain her support, Ungasan sent the spacer to kill Iza Paatzee, an assassin sent to kill Valarian.<ref name="SWG" />

As the spacer approached Paatzee, he shouted that he had been set up by Ungasan, and began firing upon the spacer. However, the spacer succeeded in killing the supposed assassin, who in fact was likely working as a patsy for Ungasan.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JabbaAssassinThief.jpg|175px|thumb|Human female depiction of Iza Paatzee, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]

Iza Paatzee is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players who perform a series of quests for Ungasan in Mos Espa must hunt down and kill Iza Paatzee outside the [[City/Legends|city]].
